name: The Cove Atlantis
positioning: The Cove at Atlantis, an all-suite tower within Atlantis on Paradise Island, steps from Cove Beach and Paradise Beach, with ocean-view suites and full access to the resort
best_for: Couples who want an adults' pool area with cabanas and every suite facing the ocean
Families who want an ocean-view suite close to Cascades Pool and the Aquaventure water park

facts.text: Of all the Atlantis hotels, The Cove is the closest to the ocean.
Suites are decorated in light woods and maritime colors of sand, coral and azure, with floor-to-ceiling windows.
Suites have walk-in closets and bathrooms with soaking tubs.
The private cabanas at The Cove Pool and Beach are reserved for guests of The Cove.
At the Lapis club, a dedicated concierge can make dinner reservations and arrange golf, spa and private cabana bookings.
The Cove's long open-air atrium has koi ponds and East Asian design flourishes.
Cove guests have full access to the attractions and amenities of Atlantis, including the 141-acre Aquaventure water park.
The Cove is very close to the family-friendly Cascades Pool and the Aquaventure water park, and has become an increasingly popular family option.
Mandara Spa at Atlantis combines Balinese healing touches, European therapies and natural indigenous elements, with warm and cold plunge pools, steam and sauna rooms.
José Andrés's restaurant Fish is located at The Cove itself.

highlights.text: The Cove Pool is an area reserved for adults, with multi-level pools, beachside cabanas with butler service and outdoor gaming.
Every suite at The Cove has ocean views, a private balcony and separate living and sleeping areas.
Lapis at The Cove is a concierge-level club on the 22nd floor for guests 12 and older staying in Lapis Club Ocean, Azure or Sapphire suites.
The Cove sits steps from Cove Beach and Paradise Beach; both beaches are reserved for Atlantis guests.
Each Bahamian-inspired cabana carries the touch of interior designer Lulu De Kwiatkowski.

considerations.text: Because The Cove is the Atlantis hotel closest to the ocean, walking times to some parts of the resort can be slightly longer.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
